summary: Frontend-only E2E of the redesigned ARSHNAZ Planning (برنامه‌ریزی) page against the local Firebase emulator (arsh_use_emulator=1, test.arshnaz@example.com / Test123456). Verified: (1) Sidebar entry 'برنامه‌ریزی' + /app/planning renders data-testid planning-view and planning-board; /app/buckets redirects to /app/planning. (2) All five level tabs planning-level-{year|quarter|month|week|day} present, default week. (3) Period picker/label, planning-prev, planning-next work; planning-now is hidden on current period and appears after going back; clicking it returns to current. (4) Week view: w1 and w2 render as plan-item-<id>; parent chips plan-parent-chip-m1 / -m2 are visible; planning-progress-text starts at '۱ از ۲' (w2 done). (5) Carry-over card planning-carryover shows old1 with planning-carryover-move/done/drop-old1; 'move here' moves it into the week list and the carryover row disappears. (6) Week-days strip planning-week-days has 7 planning-week-day-<date> buttons. (7) Upper panel planning-upper-panel lists m1/m2; plan-upper-pull-m1 creates a new child in the week (items count 13→17 incl. 'موارد جدید'/new rows) and shows plan-upper-here-m1 badge; plan-upper-step-m1 opens plan-upper-step-input-m1; plan-upper-move-m1 works. (8) Item menu plan-item-menu-<id> exposes plan-item-add-child-<id>, plan-item-move-next-<id>, plan-item-unplan-<id>. (9) Completing d1 in Day view rolls up to Week: w1 progress becomes '۱ از ۱' at 100% (visible green/purple bar). (10) planning-quick-add + planning-quick-add-submit creates 'QA_TEST_ITEM_ARSH' in current week with success toast. (11) planning-unplanned-tray lists u1/u2 with planning-unplanned-count and planning-unplanned-assign-<id>. (12) Mobile 390x800: planning-pane-main/-upper/-unplanned switch panes; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390); horizontal swipe on planning-main (JS synthesized touch) in RTL swipe-right moves to next period ('۴ مهر – ۱۰ مهر' → '۱۱ مهر – ۱۷ مهر'). (13) /app/inbox header has list-view-switch with ONLY list-view-list + list-view-buckets (no kanban), legacy task-planning-toggle absent, picking buckets renders planning-board and persists across reload; switching back to list removes the board. (14) Folder page /app/folder/<id> list-view-switch exposes list / kanban-stream / buckets and all three work; folder buckets renders planning-board. (15) /app/today header shows '۱ از ۱ تکمیل‌شده' and d1 title 'خلاصه‌نویسی...' is visible (d1 was auto-completed earlier in-test — matches rolled-up behavior rather than the spec's '۰ از ۱' which assumes an untouched seed). (16) /app/settings 'داده‌ها' tab shows data-testid firestore-usage-card. (17) Dark mode toggle (header-theme-toggle) flips documentElement.dark and planning board remains readable. (18) Regression smoke: /app/calendar, /app/notes, /app/kanban, /app/stats, /app/life-architect, /app/widgets all load with 0 console errors (filtering out benign Vite WSS and 401 emulator pre-auth noise).
critical_code_review_comments: PlanningBoard.tsx is 215 lines — within the 700-line guideline; good decomposition into PlanItemCard, UpperLevelPanel, PlanningTrays, PeriodPicker, planCascade.

ListViewSwitch: options 'list' / 'kanban-stream' / 'buckets' with data-testid list-view-<id> is clean; kanban-columns legacy still falls back to kanban-stream display, which keeps old prefs working — nice.
Legacy data-testid 'task-planning-toggle' is fully removed (grep confirms via DOM scan). Good.
planning-now button correctly hides on current period and re-appears after navigation, with a Target icon label — meets the spec's 'returns to current period only when not already there'.
Mobile swipe RTL direction (dx>0 => next) matches spec; threshold Math.abs(dx)<70 / Math.abs(dy)>45 feels right for intentional swipes.
FirestoreUsageCard renders inside Settings 'داده‌ها' tab with data-testid; good.
No console errors on 6 regression pages — good baseline.

Minor: in /app/notes, the title field is not an <input> (it's a header/contenteditable), so there is no easy data-testid for the title input; QA could not auto-fill it. Suggest adding data-testid='note-title-input' on the title editable element for future automation (not a bug, dev-ergo improvement).
test_credentials: test.arshnaz@example.com / Test123456 against local Firebase emulators (arsh_use_emulator=1); live project unused.
seed_data_creation: Seed was provided by /app/tests/emulator/start.sh (y1,y2,q1,m1,m2,w1,w2,old1,d1,u1,u2). During testing the following state changes were made and left in the emulator: (a) d1 toggled to completed; (b) old1 was moved from last-week into current week via carryover; (c) a new child of m1 titled 'مرور فصل ۲ و حل تمرین‌ها' was pulled into current week via plan-upper-pull-m1; (d) item 'QA_TEST_ITEM_ARSH' created in current week via quick-add; (e) folder 'QA_Folder' created. If next iteration wants a pristine seed, re-run `sh /app/tests/emulator/start.sh` to re-seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All planning testids required by the spec are present and wired. Login flow: localStorage.setItem('arsh_use_emulator','1') + reload before auth; disclaimer uses button[role=checkbox] (not native input) so use .click() not .check(). Vite 'wss://localhost' ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and emulator 401s before signIn are benign and should be filtered. For notes title-persist test, the title field is a contenteditable/header, not an input — needs a data-testid or evaluate() approach.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; nothing to RCA.
